It is the ctor argument of the vector constructor iterator at 004DDD6C (PUSH 0x4CB2F0 dtor, PUSH 0x4D6BA0 ctor, PUSH 8, PUSH 0x118, LEA ECX,[ESI+0x748]) inside CG_array_ctor_helper_004ddb90, the game constructor, so it builds each of the eight 0x118-byte participant records at game+748h that BSP_Game_ClaimParticipantRecord 004BB440 hands out. Partial projection: 004D6BA0-004D6C47 was read, 004D6C47-004D6CD2 was not. The read part writes vptr 00CE7794, word +10h = 0xFFFD, +14h = 2, +1Ah = 0, +28h = 2, +2Ch = 3, +38h = 00CE75CC, +3Ch = +40h = +44h = 0, byte +48h = 1, +4Ch = +50h = 0, byte +88h = 0, byte +89h = 1, float +8Ch, byte +90h = 0, +94h = 3, then the sub-object at +98h through 004C3180.
